Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this game! Cricketing action in the Under-19 World Cup continues as Sri Lanka U19 take on Afghanistan U19 in the Super League Quarter-Final 4 on Thursday, the 27th of January. That match begins at 1830 IST (1300 GMT) but our coverage will begin much sooner. Do join us then. Cheers!

England Under-19 captain, Tom Prest says they started really well with the ball and to chase it down the way they did was special. Mentions Brevis is a very good player and when he got out, it was a crucial wicket but regular wickets is what they were able to do. Adds that Rehan Ahmed bowled really well and he will be keen to do well with the bat too. Ends by saying to watch Jacob the way he played was really good and they were pleased to get 100 in the Powerplay.

The South Africa Under-19 skipper, George Van Heerden says the English played awesome cricket but they have learned a lot and he believes they were outplayed. States they started well but lost a lot of wickets in the middle overs and they were at least 30 short. Credits England for the way they played. Also says Brevis adds so much to their team and he is good in everything he does. Ends by saying it will be difficult to get over this but they will and look to improve.

Jacob Bethell is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH! Jacob says they felt 240 was a good score but they were happy when they were chasing 210 but he did not expect the way he played out there. Adds he saw the ball went and all went right for him. Mentions he was not thinking a lot and just wanted to watch the ball closely. Also says they came in with very clear plans, Brevis played a good innings but they backed their bowlers in the field.
... Presentation Time ...

South Africa needed wickets early on but their pacers were actually taken to the cleaners. They were smashed all around the park. The spinners though did a decent job. Out of the 4 wickets to fall, they took three out of which two fell to Brevis who had a brilliant game but ends up on the losing side. Have to say England were the better side by some distance and it is a well-deserved win for them.

The openers got them off to the best possible start! The two added 110 within 11 overs with Jacob slamming the ball all around the park. He fell 12 short of what would have been an amazing ton. England then did lose a few wickets here and there but they were never really under any pressure. All they needed after that opening stand was one good innings and it came from Luxton to ensure a comprehensive win for his side.

A very comfortable win for England and they have stormed into the semi finals! To be honest, after their bowlers restricted South Africa to 209, this was never in doubt. However, the ease with which they have chased this down has seen them make a real statement.

SIX! Great way to seal the match and England Under-19 are through to the semi-finals! Tossed up, around middle. William Luxton plays the slog sweep and muscles it over the mid-wicket fence for a thumping victory and he ends on 47 not-out. England Under-19 win by 6 wickets!
On off, worked towards cover-point for a single.
Flatter one, on off and sliding on with the arm. Luxton makes room to cut but has to check his shot in the end.
On off, Bell drives it towards extra cover for a single.
On off. Kept out.
A touch shorter, around off. Bell looks to punch it through cover but can't get it through.
Around off, this is cut away towards point.
Well bowled! This is floated, around off, drawing the batter forward and just turns away at the last moment. Bell is well beaten.
On the pads, flicked away to backward square leg for one.
Quicker and flatter, around off. Bell taps it towards point.
Tossed up, on middle. Luxton dances down the track and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Deft touch now from William Luxton and just a couple of hits away now England. Flatter one, close to the off stump. Luxton hangs deep and cuts it late, past first slip and into the third man fence. 200 up for England.
On middle. Blocked out.
Fired into the pads, tucked away towards mid-wicket.
A flighted ball, on middle. Luxton steps down the track and looks to go over long on but mistimes it badly past mid on. He gets a single. Just 12 required now.
FOUR! William Luxton is cruising at the moment. Tossed up, on off. Luxton brings those long levers into play and thumps it over mid on's head for a boundary.
Around off, this is driven towards cover.
Alder sees Luxton advancing and drops it short. Luxton can only manage to work it towards mid off.
Quicker and flatter, on off. Luxton stays solid in defense.
Sliding into the pads, Luxton looks to heave it away leg side but misses.
On a length, on middle. This is eased down to long on for a single.
On off, pushed away onto the off side.
FOUR! Englan edging closer to victory now. Outside off, this is sliced away behind point and the ball races away into the fence.
Fuller, on off and this is pushed towards mid off for a single.
short again, on middle. Luxton pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide, William Luxton hangs back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
On the pads, tucked away leg side for one.
Around middle and leg, Luxton looks to flick but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards backward square leg for two.
On middle, kept out.
A slight mix up but nothing to worry. On middle and just turning away. This is nudged onto the off side for a quick single.
Nicely drifted into middle. Bell looks to defend off the front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter one, angled into middle. Kept out.
FOUR! This is tossed up, on off. William Luxton lifts it with ease over mid off and the ball trickles away into the fence.
Outside off, Luxton presses forward and nudges it towrds cover.
Around off, punched off the back foot onto the off side for one.
This is pushed a bit wider and Bell edges it through backward point for a couple.
Nicely tossed up, on middle. Bell drives it straight to mid on.
Quicker, shorter and on off. This one turns a bit and Luxton does well to dab it towards third man for one.
On middle, this is pushed towards mid off.
darted into middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Flighted ball, on off. Blocked out.
On off, this is driven straight to mid off.
Full and straight, well struck but the bowler does well to get a hand on it.
Nicely drifted into middle and leg. Bell strides forward to defend.
Tossed up, outside off. Bell drives it through covers for one. Just 40 required now.
George Bell is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Dewald Brevis gets his second wicket and that looked dead straight. This is pushed through fuller, around leg stump. James Rew, from deep in his crease looks to sweep it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads and the finger is raised in a jiffy. Is there life still left in this match?
Short and wide yet again. This is cut away to deep point for one.
FOUR! Top shot! Tossed up, around middle and leg. William Luxton plays an exquisite on drive and picks up a boundary.
Around off, nudges onto the off side.
Short and wide, turning away. Luxton looks to cut but toe-end it back onto the deck.
Pushed through on a length, on off. Luxton punches it back past the bowler for a single.
Nicely flighted, on leg. Luxton makes room and eases it towards mid on.
Quicker one, full and on middle. Luxton keeps it out.
This is drifted into middle and leg. Blocked out.
Fired into middle stump, Luxton pushes it back to the bowler.
SIX! Here comes the big shot! Right in the slot, Luxton makes room and slogs it away over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Less than 50 runs required now.
A tad bit short, around off. Rew hops and plays it on the off side. Just the single off the over.
Around off. Blocked out.
Short again, outside off. Luxton cuts it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for one.
On off, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Flatter, on off. Luxton pushes it towards mid off.
Short and wide, Luxton looks to cut but almost chops it back onto the stumps.
A full toss on off, Rew pushes it to mid off.
On the pads, Luxton looks to sweep, it goes off the pad behind towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
On middle, blocked.
FOUR! Driven beautifully! Tossed up on off, Rew drives it through covers, this one beats the mid off fielder and races away to the fence.
Well fielded! On off, this is driven hard, the fielder at covers dives to his left and stops it.
On off, Luxton plays it out.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
William Luxton is in at number 5.

OUT! LBW! Dewald Brevis comes on and strikes! He can do no wrong! On middle, Prest looks to play the paddle scoop but misses. He gets hit right in front on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. 60 more needed.
On off, this is pushed to wide mid off for one.
On off, blocked.
Dewald Brevis to roll his arm now.
On off, Prest looks to guide it past first slip but the fielder dives to his right and stops it.
Angled into the pads, Prest looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
A full toss, this is eased down to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to point.
On middle, blocked.
A low full toss, this is pushed down to long off for one.
One more! On the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for one.
Another run! On the pads, this is worked around the corner.
Shorter and on the body, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Angled into the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for one.
Shorter and on off, Rew pushes it to covers.
Just wide! On middle, Prest looks to flick, it goes off the leading edge down to third man for one. South Africa need luck to go their way, for now, it is favoring England.

DRINKS! Well, it's been all England so far and just the one man has almost put this game to bed. Jacob Bethell with a sensational 88-run knock at the top of the order has made it a cakewalk for his side. South Africa have picked up a couple of wickets but with just 68 runs more required, they will need more than a miracle here.
Flatter and on middle, kept out.
Now takes one! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
SIX! That is a cracking shot! Lovely use of the feet! Prest comes down and gets to the pitch of it. He tonks it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Quicker and on the stumps, it is kept out.
Tossed up on middle, defended.
Quick run! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Another defesive stroke to this delivery on the off pole.
On off, defended.
Outside off, shorter. Prest slashes but misses.
Short but way too short on middle, Prest ducks under it. Wided.
Fuller and on middle, Prest flicks but to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on off, defended.

EDGY FOUR! Consecutive boundaries and the little pressure that was building has been released! Outside off, full, Prest goes for the booming drive, this goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
FOUR! That is a poor delivery and put away! Short and wide outside off with no protection in the deep on the off side. Rew cuts it through point and this races away to the fence.
On middle, kept out.
Tossed up on middle, blocked.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler.
On off, Prest drives it towards cover where the fielder misfields and a run is taken. South Africa can't give away such easy runs especially when the pressure is now building.
On off, blocked.
On middle, blocked.
Outside off, Rew tries to drive but misses.
On middle, defended.
James Rew is the new man at the crease for England U19.

OUT! RUN OUT! There was never a run there! Not sure why Thomas went for it. He is short by a long way. On off, this is guided towards backward point. Thomas calls for one. They go for it. Andile Simelane at point, runs to his left and then fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off. It is taken upstairs and replays show that the batter is well short. Two wickets in quick succession. South Africa will just start believing a little.

Is that a run out? South Africa seem confident. The umpires have gone upstairs just to be sure and we can see on the replay that Thomas is not even in the frame. OUT is the decision on the big screen England give away an unnecessary wicket here.
Quicker and outside off, Prest looks to cut but is beaten.
Shorter and on off, Prest guides it to point.
A dot to end a tidy over! On off, this is guided to extra cover.
On the pads, Thomas looks to flick, closes the face of the bat early and it goes off a soft leading edge on the off side.
Prest comes down the track and almost yorks himself. He looks to get his bat down, it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
Quicker and on off, Prest once again plays it to covers.
On off, Prest pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
A single to end another expensive over! On the pads, Prest flicks it through square leg for one.
Quick run! On the pads, Thomas nudges it on the leg side and takes one.
Tossed up on off, Prest looks to drive, this goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! They just can't put a stop to the boundaries at the moment! Another one on the pads, Prest sweeps it over square leg and this races away to the fence.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FIVE WIDES! Runs continue to flow! Down the leg side, Prest looks to sweep but misses. The keeper fails to collect it and it goes to the fine leg fence.
On off, this is pushed down to long off. Prest is off the mark.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
The skipper, Tom Prest is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Something to rejoice about for South Africa! End of a special innings from Jacob Bethell but he will be gutted he did not score a ton here. It was on the offer but he actually throws it away. He could have easily just nudged it around and got to his ton but he tried to continue the way he has been playing and falls in the attempt. He plays the slog sweep, drags this from outside off, hits it really well but straight to deep mid-wiket where Ethan-John Cunningham takes it. Jacob Bethell though has done his job. For South Africa, they need maybe three or four more quickly.
Commentary.Howout: c Ethan-John Cunningham b Asakhe Tshaka

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Jacob really wants to end this in a hurry! On middle, he plays the reverse sweep, he hits it over point and it trickles away to the fence. Exactly 100 needed now.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
SIX! George Thomas joins the party now! Right in the slot, Thomas smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie. England Under-19 are 104/0 at the end of Powerplay 1!
FOUR! A gentle half volley, on middle and leg. George Thomas times it through the mid-wicket region and picks up a boundary.
It's not happening at the moment for Thomas. Slower and shorter, outside off. Thomas again looks to fetch and swipe across but misses.
On off, defended out by Thomas.

Just safe! After being hammered, finally, a chance brews for South Africa but Bethell survives. Fuller one, angled into middle and leg, Bethell looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge which flies over cover-point. The fielder from point tries his best to put in the dive but it's just beyond his reach. Single taken.
FOUR! On a good length, angled into middle. Bethell stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for yet another boundary. There is no stopping this young man at the moment.
On off, driven towards the cover region.
On a length, around off and this one turns a bit. Thomas looks to stand tall and drive but gets an inside edge back onto the deck.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Jacob Bethell gets down to sweep and he does so firmly but straight to deep mid-wikcet. Single taken.
On middle, blocked out.
Nicely bowled. A flighted delivery, on off. Bethell looks to drive but has to check his shot in the end.
FOUR! A juicy full toss, outside off. Jacob Bethell dances down the track and powers it into the wide long on fence.
Thomas has been watching from the other end for quite a while now and wants a piece of action himself. Short and wide, Thomas looks to fetch and pull it across but misses it completely.
Back of a length, on off. Thomas hops to defend.
Around middle and leg, flicked away towards square leg for one.
Length again, sliding down leg. Bethell looks to flick it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! Different bowler, same treatment from Bethell. Short, on off and this one sits up nicely for the batter. Bethell stands tall and pulls it well in front of square for a boundary.
A length ball, on middle. Defended back to the bowler.
Sliding onto the pads, Bethell hops back and tucks it 'round the corner for one.
SIX! It's just too easy at the moment for Jacob Bethell. On off, slogged away flat and hard over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Cheeky! Full, on middle. Jacob Bethell plays the reverse sweep and gets it behind point for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Bethell is pushed back and he works it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted, on off. Thomas drives it towards long off for a single.
Very full, on off. This is pushed away onto the off side.
Back of a length, on off. Bethell defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! He won't miss two in a row. This is poor bowling though from Mnyanda. Halfway down the track, around off. Bethell stays on top of the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
For once, Bethell mistimes the pull. Banged in around off and Bethell pulls it straight to mid-wicket.
On the pads, worked away behind square on the leg side for a couple. Runs are bleeding here for South Africa and they desperately need wickets.
A good-length ball, angled into middle. Bethell keeps it out.
FOUR! Fifty up for Jacob Bethell in more than double-quick time! Full and straight, drills the on drive back past the bowler for yet another boundary. He's scored 46 runs out of his 51 in boundaries.
Good running. Around the hips, tucked away onto the leg side for one more.
SIX! Sensational! Pitched up, around off. Jacob Bethell makes a bit of room and thumps it over mid on and the ball flies all the way and hits the ropes on the full.
Fuller in length, on middle. Thomas flicks it away nicely but straight to mid-wicket for a quick single. Fifty up for England Under-19.
Around off, Thomas gets an inside edge onto the pads as he looks to defend it out.
Around middle and leg. Blocked out.
Sliding into middle and leg, Thomas flicks it through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! A nineth boundary already for Jacob Bethell! On a good length, Bethell takes a couple of steps down the track and muscles it into the square leg fence with ease.
FOUR! Back of a length, around off. Bethell hangs back and this time pulls it along the ground and once again it's in front of square. Yet another boundary for him.
WIDE! Wayward from Mnyanda. This is an effort ball but it is spilled way down the leg side.
Length again, angled into middle. Bethell stays solid in defense.
Around the top of off, this is tapped towards cover.
Uppish but well controlled. On the pads, Bethell clips it aerially into the vacant mid-wicket region and picks up a couple of runs.
WIDE! Full and angling down leg. Wided.
On off. Blocked out.

Just out of reach! Matthew Boast almost had his redemption here. On a good length, angled across off but this one straightens a touch. Bethell is caught on the crease and knicks it. The keeper dives sharply to his left but only manages to get a finger on it. The ball goes behind and they take one.
FOUR! Make that four in a row! Full and wide, Bethell throws his hands at it and drives it uppishly through the cover region for another boundary.
FOUR! A hat-trick of boundaries now! Banged in short, on off. Bethell climbs on top of the bounce and pulls it in front of square for another boundary. Matthew Boast in all sorts of pressure here.
FOUR! Geez, that is an exquisite cover drive! A length ball, outside off. Bethell presses forward and caresses it on the up, through extra cover and the ball just hares away into the fence.
FOUR! Crunched! A short ball, angled across off. Jacob Bethell hangs back and muscles the pull shot over mid-wicket and into the fence.
Sliding down the leg side, Thomas tickles it down to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Top shot! Jacob Bethell seems like he's been batting for over an hour. Pitched up, on off and it is a glorious off drive, past mid off and the ball races away into the fence.
Back of a length, at the body. Bethell defends it off the back foot.
Full, on off. This is driven firmly towards mid off and the fielder over there makes a good half stop. They scamper through for one.
On the pads, tucked away towards square leg for a single.

Lucky! On a length, angled across off. Thomas looks for the booming cover drive but gets an inside edge past the stumps towards fine leg. They get a single. Now, did that also clip the leg stump? There was a double noiuse for sure.
Fullish ball, outside off and trying to shape it back in. Thomas leaves it alone.
A length ball, on the pads. Bethell looks to flick but misses.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Aphiwe Mnyanda.
FOUR! Sublime timing! A half-volley, around off. Jacob Bethell leans into the cover drive and creams it through the inner ring for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Classy way to get off the mark! A touch short and wide, Jacob Bethell waits for it and then cuts it hard, behind point and into the fence for the first boundary of the innings.
George Thomas is off the mark. Around off, Thomas drops it on the off side and sets off for a quick single. Good running.
On middle, this is flicked away on the leg side.
Good shape early on. On a length, around off and moving away. Left alone.
WIDE! Boast starts with a fullish ball, down the leg side. England Under-19 are underway with that wide call.
